title: thorvg: Update to 0.15.5
body:
https://github.com/thorvg/thorvg/releases/tag/v0.15.5
<details open>
<summary>Changes</summary>

- [Renderer] Fixed an issue where paint transformations were omitted during scene changes.
- [Renderer] Added support for the SceneEffect DropShadow feature, enhancing visual depth with shadow effects.
- [GlEngine] Resolved incorrect stroke alpha calculation.
- [Lottie] Added support for the DropShadow layer effect, enhancing Lottie animations with shadow options.
- [Lottie] Added support for min/max easing and shapes for text range selectors.
- [Lottie] Addressed a minor bug in trimpath expressions.
- [Lottie] Improved slot overriding, ensuring duplicate keyframe data is handled correctly.
- [Lottie] Enhanced Lottie parser stability.
- [SVG] Corrected handling of the "currentColor" attribute within gradients.
- [Portability] Fixed a compilation issue with LVGL integration.
- [Example] Resolved resource leaks in GL and WebGPU canvases by refining usage guidance.
</details>

---

https://github.com/thorvg/thorvg/releases/tag/v0.15.4
<details>
<summary>Changes</summary>

- [SwEngine] Enhanced minor stability for a smoother user experience.
- [GlEngine] Introduced support for radial gradient focal functions, enabling more versatile gradient designs.
- [GlEngine] Resolved performance degradation caused by repeated clip drawing operations.
- [Lottie] Revised gradient fill data parsing by adding support for the color stop count (p) parameter in slot data.
- [Lottie] Implemented support for overriding default slots.
- [Lottie] Enhanced slots to correctly override solid fill opacity and image attributes.
- [Lottie] Added support for text alignment options, improving text layout flexibility.
- [Lottie] Enabled smoothness and maxAmount specification for text range selectors.
- [Lottie] Fixed minor memory leaks to ensure better resource handling.
</details>

---

https://github.com/thorvg/thorvg/releases/tag/v0.15.3
<details>
<summary>Changes</summary>

- [Renderer] Hotfixed an issue with broken SVG file sharing.
- [SwEngine] Fixed an issue with Gaussian Blur feathering when applied in one directional filter.
- [SwEngine] Fixed a regression bug that impacted rendering regions.
- [Lottie] Adjusted Text Range Selector transformation to ensure accurate positioning.
- [Lottie] Corrected a shallow keyframe data copy bug.
- [SVG] Enhanced runtime stability by preventing invalid memory access.
</details>

---

https://github.com/thorvg/thorvg/releases/tag/v0.15.2
<details>
<summary>Changes</summary>

- [SwEngine] Optimized render region updates to minimize unnecessary rendering tasks.
- [SwEngine] Fixed a crash by splitting long lines to prevent overflow.
- [SwEngine] Fixed incorrect 8bits linear gradient filling masking.
- [SwEngine] Rectified a wrong 8bits channel data blending in direct image drawing.
- [GlEngine] Added support for the Path Trimming feature.
- [GlEngine] Fixed an wrong png colorspace.
- [GlEngine] Corrected a wrong masking alpha multiplication when applying the Inverse Luma Masking.
- [Lottie] Enhanced performance for Gaussian Blur effects.
- [Lottie] Added support for Masking Expansion (Dilate).
- [Lottie] Optimized memory management by releasing JSON data immediately after loading.
- [Lottie] Fixed regression bugs causing gradient fills to matte masked, incorrectly.
- [Lottie] Rectified Offset Path to ignore the path direction according to its Spec.
</details>

---

https://github.com/thorvg/thorvg/releases/tag/v0.15.1
<details>
<summary>Changes</summary>

- [Lottie] Fixed a crash when the image external path is not addressed.
</details>
